import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for brands
brand_colors = {'Leica': '#E41A1C', 'Fuji': '#377EB8', 'Pentax': '#4DAF4A', 'Olympus': '#984EA3'}

# 1. Price by Brand (Bar chart)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax1.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index])
ax1.set_xlabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
for i, v in enumerate(brand_prices.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, f'${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price (Scatter plot)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax2.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution (Pie chart)
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 4. Weight vs Max ISO (Scatter plot with size by megapixels)
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax4.scatter(brand_data['weight_grams'], brand_data['max_iso'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], label=brand, s=brand_data['megapixels']*5, 
                alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO (size = megapixels)')
ax4.legend()

# 5. Body Type by Brand (Grouped bar)
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
body_brand = pd.crosstab(df['body_type'], df['brand'])
body_brand.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=[brand_colors[b] for b in body_brand.columns], 
                edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Body Type Distribution by Brand')
ax5.legend(title='Brand')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Model Year vs Megapixels (Timeline)
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df_sorted[df_sorted['brand'] == brand]
    ax6.plot(brand_data['model_year'], brand_data['megapixels'], 'o-', 
             color=brand_colors[brand], label=brand, markersize=10, linewidth=2)
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax6.set_ylabel('Megapixels')
ax6.set_title('Megapixels Evolution Over Years')
ax6.legend()
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
